cases.prompt: Which court exercises appellate jurisdiction over court-martial convictions under the Army Act 1950?
cases.expected_answer: Armed Forces Tribunal (AFT)
cases.statutory_authority: Armed Forces Tribunal Act, 2007 (Section 15)

cases.prompt: Is the judgment in ADM Jabalpur v. Shivkant Shukla (AIR 1976 SC 1207) currently good law in India?
cases.expected_answer: No, it was expressly overruled by a 9-judge Constitution bench in K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India (2017).
cases.statutory_authority: Articles 21 and 141; Puttaswamy (2017) 10 SCC 1

cases.prompt: Can a 2-judge Division Bench of the Supreme Court overrule a 5-judge Constitution Bench?
cases.expected_answer: No. Under Article 141 and established precedent hierarchy, a bench can only be overruled by a bench of larger numerical strength.
cases.statutory_authority: Union of India v. Raghubir Singh (1989) 2 SCC 754

cases.prompt: What official legislative enactment was directly formulated in response to the Supreme Court's guidelines in Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan (1997)?
cases.expected_answer: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH Act)
cases.statutory_authority: Statement of Objects and Reasons, POSH Act 2013

cases.prompt: Under what statutory provisions is it prohibited to publish the name or identity of a rape survivor in India?
cases.expected_answer: Section 228A of the Indian Penal Code 1860 and Section 72 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023.
cases.statutory_authority: Section 228A IPC / Section 72 BNS 2023; Nipun Saxena v. Union of India (2019)

cases.prompt: What is the current status of Suresh Kumar Koushal v. Naz Foundation (2014)?
cases.expected_answer: Overruled by a 5-judge bench in Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India (2018).
cases.statutory_authority: Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India (2018) 1 SCC 791

cases.prompt: What is the current status of Sowmithri Vishnu v. Union of India (1985)?
cases.expected_answer: Overruled by a 5-judge Constitution Bench in Joseph Shine v. Union of India (2018).
cases.statutory_authority: Joseph Shine v. Union of India (2018) 2 SCC 189

cases.prompt: What happened to Section 66A of the Information Technology Act 2000 after the Supreme Court decision in Shreya Singhal (2015)?
cases.expected_answer: Section 66A was struck down in its entirety as unconstitutional for violating Article 19(1)(a).
cases.statutory_authority: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India (2015) 5 SCC 1

cases.prompt: What was the highest judicial tribunal for British Indian appeals prior to 1949?
cases.expected_answer: Judicial Committee of the Privy Council (abolished by Abolition of Privy Council Jurisdiction Act, 1949).
cases.statutory_authority: Abolition of Privy Council Jurisdiction Act 1949

cases.prompt: Between 1937 and 1950, which court functioned as the predecessor to the Supreme Court of India?
cases.expected_answer: Federal Court of India
cases.statutory_authority: Government of India Act 1935, Part IX

cases.prompt: What does the citation format '2023 INSC 101' represent?
cases.expected_answer: The official Neutral Citation for the Supreme Court of India, judgment number 101 of year 2023.
cases.statutory_authority: Supreme Court of India Neutral Citation System Circular (2023)

cases.prompt: What does the citation format '2023:DHC:1234' represent?
cases.expected_answer: The official Neutral Citation for the High Court of Delhi, judgment number 1234 of year 2023.
cases.statutory_authority: High Court of Delhi Neutral Citation Guidelines

cases.prompt: Under which constitutional article do High Courts exercise administrative superintendence over District Courts?
cases.expected_answer: Article 227 of the Constitution of India.
cases.statutory_authority: Article 227, Constitution of India

cases.prompt: Which tribunal hears statutory appeals from orders of the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT)?
cases.expected_answer: National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (NCLAT)
cases.statutory_authority: Companies Act 2013 (Section 410) & IBC 2016 (Section 61)

cases.prompt: What is the principal forum for statutory disputes under the National Green Tribunal Act 2010?
cases.expected_answer: National Green Tribunal (NGT)
cases.statutory_authority: National Green Tribunal Act, 2010

cases.prompt: Which amendments to the CrPC codified the arrest guidelines issued in D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal (1997)?
cases.expected_answer: Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Act, 2008 (inserting Sections 41A, 41B, 41C, and 41D).
cases.statutory_authority: CrPC (Amendment) Act 2008 (Act 5 of 2009)

cases.prompt: Does the POCSO Act 2012 permit disclosing a child victim's school name or photograph in case reports?
cases.expected_answer: No, Section 74 of the POCSO Act strictly prohibits disclosing the child's school, address, or photograph.
cases.statutory_authority: POCSO Act 2012, Section 74

cases.prompt: Was Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala (1973) overruled by any subsequent bench?
cases.expected_answer: No, it remains good law and forms the bedrock of the Basic Structure Doctrine in Indian Constitutional Law.
cases.statutory_authority: Minerva Mills (1980) 3 SCC 625; I.R. Coelho (2007) 2 SCC 1

cases.prompt: In LegalMitra's 11-tier coverage framework, what does Tier 1 designate?
cases.expected_answer: Catalogued: The institution's identity, jurisdiction, and historical predecessor are catalogued, but records are not yet ingested.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Tier Framework (Tier 0 to Tier 10)

cases.prompt: In LegalMitra's 11-tier coverage framework, what does Tier 5 designate?
cases.expected_answer: Sampling Validated: A representative sample of judgments is ingested, OCR quality audited, and metadata verified.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Tier Framework

cases.prompt: Under which substantive domain does a petition challenging an environmental clearance under the NGT Act fall?
cases.expected_answer: ENVIRONMENTAL_FOREST
cases.statutory_authority: National Green Tribunal Act 2010

cases.prompt: Under which substantive domain does an application under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 fall?
cases.expected_answer: COMMERCIAL_CORPORATE_INSOLVENCY
cases.statutory_authority: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016

cases.prompt: Which High Courts were the earliest established under the Indian High Courts Act 1861?
cases.expected_answer: Calcutta High Court (July 1862), Bombay High Court (August 1862), and Madras High Court (August 1862).
cases.statutory_authority: Indian High Courts Act 1861 (24 & 25 Vict. c. 104)

cases.prompt: Can a legislative change be classified as a direct response to a judgment if only temporal sequence is known?
cases.expected_answer: No. Under LegalMitra's evidentiary standard, it must be classified as MERE_TEMPORAL_SEQUENCE unless official documents (SOR, debates, Law Commission) establish causation.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Evidentiary Standards

cases.prompt: Are decisions of the Armed Forces Tribunal subject to writ jurisdiction of High Courts under Article 226?
cases.expected_answer: Yes, a 5-judge bench in Union of India v. Parashotam Dass (2023) held that High Courts can exercise supervisory jurisdiction under Article 226 over AFT orders.
cases.statutory_authority: Union of India v. Parashotam Dass, 2023 INSC 261

cases.prompt: Which famous dissent in Indian constitutional history was subsequently affirmed by a 9-judge bench in Puttaswamy (2017) as the correct statement of law?
cases.expected_answer: Justice H.R. Khanna's dissent in ADM Jabalpur v. Shivkant Shukla (1976).
cases.statutory_authority: Puttaswamy (2017) 10 SCC 1, Para 122

cases.prompt: In the Nirbhaya litigation (State v. Mukesh & Ors.), what was the final constitutional procedural remedy exhausted before the Supreme Court prior to execution?
cases.expected_answer: Curative Petition under the doctrine of Rupa Ashok Hurra v. Ashok Hurra (dismissed on January 14, 2020).
cases.statutory_authority: Curative Petition (Crl.) Nos. 1-4 of 2020 (Supreme Court of India)

cases.prompt: In the landmark Federal Court case Niharendu Dutt Majumdar (1942 FCR 38), what did Sir Maurice Gwyer C.J. define as the gist of the offence of sedition under Section 124A IPC?
cases.expected_answer: Public disorder or the reasonable anticipation or likelihood of public disorder.
cases.statutory_authority: Niharendu Dutt Majumdar v. King-Emperor, [1942] F.C.R. 38

cases.prompt: In Pakala Narayana Swami v. King-Emperor (1939 L.R. 66 I.A. 66), how did Lord Atkin define a confession under the Indian Evidence Act 1872?
cases.expected_answer: An admission in terms of the offence, or substantially all the facts which constitute the offence; a statement containing self-exculpatory matter cannot be a confession.
cases.statutory_authority: (1939) L.R. 66 I.A. 66 (Privy Council)

cases.prompt: Under what initiative does the Supreme Court of India officially translate and publish reported judgments into Hindi and regional scheduled languages?
cases.expected_answer: The eSCR (electronic Supreme Court Reports) portal utilizing SUVAS (Supreme Court Vidhik Anuvaad Software) AI translation.
cases.statutory_authority: Supreme Court of India eSCR Vernacular Translation Initiative (2023)

cases.prompt: If a user requests the unreported trial record of a 1920 district court civil suit where no official digitized record exists, what must the system do?
cases.expected_answer: Abstain from answering with fabricated facts, disclose that the physical record is unmapped or offline, and report the specific coverage gap.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Truthful Reporting & Abstention Policy

cases.prompt: Which forum has original jurisdiction to adjudicate corporate insolvency applications under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016?
cases.expected_answer: National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office of the corporate debtor.
cases.statutory_authority: Section 5(1) and Section 60(1) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016

cases.prompt: What parliamentary statute resulted from the Supreme Court decision in Shayara Bano v. Union of India (2017) declaring triple talaq void?
cases.expected_answer: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019.
cases.statutory_authority: Statement of Objects and Reasons, Act 20 of 2019

cases.prompt: How does LegalMitra resolve differences in party names between 'Union of India', 'UOI', and 'Govt. of India' across parallel citations?
cases.expected_answer: Through the CaseIdentityResolver's rule-based litigant alias mapping, canonicalizing them to 'Union of India' before cryptographic identity hashing.
cases.statutory_authority: legalmitra.judicial.identity_resolver.CaseIdentityResolver

cases.prompt: What is the principal difference between a Summary Court-Martial (SCM) and a General Court-Martial (GCM) under the Army Act 1950?
cases.expected_answer: An SCM is constituted by a single officer (Commanding Officer alone) with limited sentencing power (up to 1 year imprisonment), whereas a GCM requires at least 5 officers and can award any sentence authorized by law including the death penalty.
cases.statutory_authority: Sections 113, 116, 118, and 120 of the Army Act, 1950

cases.prompt: How does the High Court connector handle requests targeting internal IP addresses (e.g., 169.254.169.254, 127.0.0.1, or 10.0.0.1)?
cases.expected_answer: It raises an SSRFProtectionError and halts the request immediately, ensuring zero egress to private or loopback networks.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra SSRF Guard Policy & Judicial Connector Architecture

cases.prompt: What safeguard prevents High Court connector requests from overwhelming official judicial web portals?
cases.expected_answer: Token bucket rate limiter with a 1.0 QPS cap, bounded response size enforcement, and exponential backoff retry jitter.
cases.statutory_authority: Judicial Connector Architecture & Court Portal Etiquette Rules

cases.prompt: What is the official structure of a 16-character Case Number Record (CNR) in the Indian eCourts system?
cases.expected_answer: 2 letters for state code, 2 letters for district code, 2 alphanumeric characters for court establishment, 6 digits for case number, and 4 digits for filing year.
cases.statutory_authority: eCourts Project Phase II Rules, eCommittee Supreme Court of India

cases.prompt: What are the sequential stages through which an eCourts district court record must pass before indexing?
cases.expected_answer: CATALOGUED -> METADATA_ACQUIRED -> DOCUMENT_ACQUIRED -> AUTHENTICITY_VALIDATED -> PROCEDURAL_EXTRACTED -> PRIVACY_REVIEWED -> ELIGIBLE_INDEXED.
cases.statutory_authority: eCourts CIS Ingestion Protocol v1.0

cases.prompt: If an eCourts record contains allegations under the POCSO Act 2012 or Section 228A IPC, what is its lifecycle classification?
cases.expected_answer: BLOCKED_RESTRICTED: It is quarantined from public retrieval until certified redaction occurs, and permanently excluded from ML training datasets.
cases.statutory_authority: Section 74 POCSO Act 2012, Section 228A IPC 1860, Nipun Saxena v. UOI (2019)

cases.prompt: How does the Devanagari OCR pipeline preserve textual fidelity while fixing OCR artifacts?
cases.expected_answer: It uses conservative Unicode NFC normalization, validates danda and double danda spacing, replaces Unicode replacement characters, and immutably preserves the raw OCR string.
cases.statutory_authority: Unicode Standard Version 15.0 & LegalMitra OCR Quality Architecture

cases.prompt: Name key Hindi legal tokens that the Devanagari OCR QA engine monitors to detect corruption in judicial orders.
cases.expected_answer: जमानत (bail), दोषसिद्धि (conviction), बरी (acquittal), धारा (section), अनुच्छेद (article), उच्चतम न्यायालय (Supreme Court), and सत्र न्यायालय (Sessions Court).
cases.statutory_authority: Ministry of Law & Justice Hindi Legal Glossary & LegalMitra Devanagari Engine

cases.prompt: What metric is used by the Devanagari OCR engine to evaluate character-level transcription fidelity against reference judgments?
cases.expected_answer: Character Error Rate (CER), computed via dynamic programming Levenshtein distance normalized by reference character count.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra OCR Evaluation Metric Specification

cases.prompt: Can an automated machine learning algorithm or unauthorized user mark a precedent conflict as resolved in LegalMitra?
cases.expected_answer: No. The system raises a PermissionError. Resolving or distinguishing precedent conflicts requires verified human advocate review credentials.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Human-in-the-Loop Judicial Governance Protocol

cases.prompt: What evidentiary requirement must be met before a conflict between two High Court rulings is accepted into the register?
cases.expected_answer: Both cases must have verified, pinpoint paragraph or page anchors referencing the exact contradictory proposition.
cases.statutory_authority: Precedent Conflict Triage Protocol (Evidentiary Anchoring Requirement)

cases.prompt: When the Delhi High Court and Bombay High Court reach opposing conclusions on the interpretation of a central statute, what is the precedential effect?
cases.expected_answer: Neither decision overrules the other. Each is binding within its territorial jurisdiction and merely persuasive in the other, until resolved by the Supreme Court.
cases.statutory_authority: Article 227 and Article 141; V.M. Salgaocar & Bros v. CIT (2000) 5 SCC 373

cases.prompt: How does the Precedent Conflict Triage Manager prioritize competing conflicts for review?
cases.expected_answer: Conflicts are ranked in descending order of priority score, with constitutional questions and national economic impact receiving highest priority.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Conflict Triage Priority Engine

cases.prompt: What must the system do when asked for an unverified subordinate court decree not present in the verified corpus?
cases.expected_answer: It must explicitly state that the record is not in the verified corpus, refuse to hallucinate terms, and invite entry of an official 16-character CNR.
cases.statutory_authority: LegalMitra Verifiable Retrieval & Groundedness Invariant
